Create a Scandinavian village of roughly seven raised thatched log buildings around an open muddy yard, with the largest hall facing inward. Connect cabins with curving paths and add partial animal enclosures, a firepit, sparse work props, and a few grazing animals. Blend the irregular edge into flowered meadow and low hills.
